pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...c5 3.Bxf6
pages.notes: Overview called the g5-bishop light-squared; plan 1 named e5 as a light square; plan 2 called the g-file open. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...c5 3.Bxf6 gxf6 4.d5 Qb6 5.Qc1
pages.notes: Plan 3 prevented a ...Bb4 that the e7- and c5-pawns block; plan 4 put the light-squared bishop on g7; plans called the g-file open. Rewrote overview and plans 2-4 (...Bh6 hitting the c1-queen).

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...c5 3.d5 Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 4 read b3, c3 and a3 as moves; plan 1 offered Rb1 with the knight on b1 and Nc3 as a defence of b2 (it is a gambit). Rewrote plans 1 and 4 (reviewer rejection fixed and re-reviewed).

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...c5 3.dxc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 solidified a d4-pawn that 3.dxc5 has just moved. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...c5 3.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured Nxd4 with a knight that cannot reach d4 (the queen recaptures). Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...e6 3.e4 h6 4.Bxf6 Qxf6 5.Nc3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 3 read d3 as a move (Bd3 meant). Fixed plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bf4 c5 4.f3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e2-e4 onto Black's knight. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bf4 c5 4.f3 Qa5+
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e2-e4 onto Black's knight. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bf4 c5 4.f3 Qa5+ 5.c3 Nf6 6.Nd2
pages.notes: Plan 3 recaptured Nxd4 with the d2-knight, developed Nf3 onto the f3-pawn and wrote castling as 0-0; plan 4 fianchettoed the light-squared bishop to g7. Rewrote plans 3-4 (reviewer rejection fixed with the 7.Nb3 idea and re-reviewed).

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bf4 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4 onto Black's knight; plan 3 rerouted a knight via Nd2-f1-e3; plan 4 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.
